text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was back around New Year's Eve. The 
public was buzzing with excitement over a 
certain topic.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, did you see that?! Oguri Cap and 
Tamamo Cross's race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! But Super Creek was 
amazing there too, wasn't she~...! It was 
like she forced her way right between 
their one-on-one duel.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
With such strong Umamusume in the Twinkle 
Series, I can't wait to see what next year 
brings!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The media's making quite a fuss about it 
too! Calling them the 'Big Three' defining 
the era and all...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ but rumor has it Tamamo Cross might be 
retiring from the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She could barely eat to begin with, and 
now her appetite's gone down even more. 
Her legs were feeling a bit heavy too, so 
I decided to have her take a break for a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's a sign from my body. 
...Telling me that it's time to call it 
quits."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Well, this kinda thing just comes with an 
athlete's life. Knowing when to step back 
is key in anything, so I'll listen to my 
body and decide my future."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"I saw that press conference online too... 
But it's gonna be lonely if she really 
leaves~ Just when things were getting 
exciting, too—"
Whoa there, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ain't you forgetting someone?! The 
Umamusume who's gonna bring glory back 
home to Ohi— Inari One, that's who!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh~, nice one, Inari!! Sweep up a 
whole haul of GⅠs next year and make it 
your year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If she blows away both Oguri and Creek, 
Inari really will be the undisputed 
champion!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Right, got it! Don't you folks just 
settle for watching on the screen—come 
cheer me on at the track, alright?!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Lighting up at the finish line is the Edo 
flower! Inari One is gonna sweep away the 
whole show!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the new year dawned, bringing with it 
the feeling of a whole new era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even now, formidable rivals are emerging 
one after another. Everyone around is 
wondering who will carry the next era—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you watch Tamamo's press 
conference online as well?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It really caught me by surprise. Time 
really waits for no one, does it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Swept along ever forward... so many things 
end up changing.
choice_data_list:
Still, your feelings haven't changed, have 
they?

But your feelings haven't changed, have 
they?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's exactly right, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
To tighten our resolve for the new year, 
let us renew our vows here and now.
choice_data_list:
Health comes first—excessive solo training 
is strictly forbidden!
Let's work on the basics so you can grow.

Let's learn some skills to blow past the 
competition too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! Could it be that you're still a 
little mad about me secretly doing extra 
training before the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I said I won't do it again! Please 
don't look at me like that~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Definitely, definitely, totally promised! 
Look, I'll even swear to God!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all, Sakura Chiyono O and I offered 
our New Year's prayers together like this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, there. Ah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, then this is the perfect time for the 
Chiyo-Notebook!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, in here, all the strengths and 
weaknesses that Trainer pointed out to me 
are written down, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Wanna see? My weakness.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“Well, you probably already knew that 
much, Trainer. Ehehe...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all, Sakura Chiyono O and I offered 
our New Year's prayers together like this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, there. Ah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Scatter them... Kick 'em out of the way... 
...Hmph, mmgh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh, hyaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Towaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
H-How do I look...? I tried to pump myself 
up just like Yaeno-san, but...
choice_data_list:
...As far as storylines go, it's not bad, 
I guess?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... Yaeno-san told me the exact 
same thing when she was teaching me 
self-defense before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all, Sakura Chiyono O and I offered 
our New Year's prayers together like this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, there. Ah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"That takoyaki smells so delicious... The 
sauce and bonito flakes blend together so 
softly..."
choice_data_list: Wanna stop by the stalls too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-No! I'm not hungry at all! Really, 
I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's head back quickly! 
My legs are itching to run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Phew... *inhale*... ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle, clatter, clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"...Lady Ardan, were you trying to do your 
rehab by yourself in secret again?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I am truly sorry. I only hope to get 
back into top form as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
“...... But recklessly pushing your body 
is no shortcut to recovery.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That is... ...something I am well aware 
of.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is why we ask that you please 
consult us regarding how to make a swift 
return.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
We who serve the Mejiro family are your 
hands, your legs, and your head. Please 
make use of us as you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from the academy, Sakura 
Chiyono O suddenly came to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, I was just thinking that this is near 
the hospital Ardan-san is staying at...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Ardan-san saw it too. My run, 
I mean.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...No, I can't rely on Ardan-san just 
because she's watching over me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to do so well that they 
won't be able to look away!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That motivation of Sakura Chiyono O's 
carried over even after we returned to the 
academy.
